claim_summary: At an interior Hopf point of the two-strategy logit ecological feedback model, the cubic Hopf sign is strictly negative for all positive environmental speeds if the replenishment parameter is at least one third. For smaller replenishment it can cross once from negative to positive as environmental speed increases; with the explicit admissible payoffs (s,R,T,P)=(-1,2,1,40) and replenishment 1/4, the unique crossing speed is approximately 315.436450053502. On the two sides of that speed, the same payoff game has locally attracting or repelling Hopf cycles, respectively.

integrity.proof: Analytical equilibrium, derivative and Hopf normal-form calculation in RESULT.md
integrity.publication_priority: best-knowledge literature comparison; independent assessment outstanding
integrity.reproducibility: Standalone Python standard-library verify.py checks exact rational identities and witness arithmetic

scientific_limitations: Only existing interior nondegenerate Hopf points are classified.
At the zero-cubic crossing no nonzero fifth-order coefficient or Bautin bifurcation is asserted.
Cycles are local; global basins, stochastic games, and large-amplitude persistence are not established.
A relevant 2026 publication was not accessible in full text; publication priority remains uncertain.
title: Environmental response speed reverses Hopf criticality in logit ecological games
